primitive.relation: definitional equality: Chromatic X130's x130_bfold_colouring and Extremal D2chr's bfold_colouring (the same body up to the binder annotation v : G, both unchanged since authoring) are GTBase.bfold_colourings.bfold_colouring b f: every vertex v gets a b-element subset f v of the supplied palette 'I_a and adjacent vertices get disjoint subsets, with no guard (b = 0 and an empty vertex type allowed; a vertex forces b <= a and an edge 2 * b <= a). The fractional-chromatic consumers stay distinct and are not migrated: X130's x130_frac_chi_le is an existential cross-multiplied natural bound and D2chr's is_fractional_chromatic an attained rational minimum, each with its own 0 < b.

uniform-b-fold-colouring.note: bfold_colouring b f over a supplied f : G -> {set 'I_a}: #|f v| = b for every vertex and [disjoint f x & f y] on every edge; bfold_colouringP gives the finite Boolean form.

upstream_audit.note: The pinned GraphTheory (core/coloring.v: cliques and the clique number) and MathComp have no b-fold, multicolouring or fractional colouring notion; a search of all 39 pinned GraphTheory sources for fractional / b-fold / multicolouring finds none. Ownership rule 3: the body is used by two area packages (Chromatic X130, Extremal D2chr, the latter also consumed by Atlas.fractional), so it is placed in GTBase, in a focused module without conjecture imports or base re-export.
